artifacts.summary: A stalled Pi live run leaves artifacts the runner already archives, but nothing classifies the stall, so each stall costs a re-run and teaches nothing. Capture is not the gap: the Claude-lane capture task stays out of this sprint and states Pi needs no capture change. The seed asks for a classification of a Pi stall from the archived artifacts, within stated limits.
